title: Line-Star Rank Correction and Matter-Sector Interpretation
architecture_upgrade: Corrects the line-star gauge rank accounting: the K4 line-stars span the full X-logical/matter sector modulo vertex checks. They are not disposable stabilizers; they are the local low-distance representation of the 81 protected degrees.
theorem: The 160 K4 line-star triples span a 120-dimensional subspace equal to ker(H_Z). Modulo the 39 vertex checks, this gives an 81-dimensional quotient, exactly the W33 logical/matter sector. Adding them as stabilizers would collapse k to zero.
honesty_boundary: This supersedes the rank-effect statement in CCCCVIII. The next fault-tolerance layer must re-encode the line-star/matter degrees into a higher-distance tomotope/chirality or inner-code packet rather than gauge them away.
